## Summary

Describe the user-facing change and the reason for it.

## Evidence

List the validation commands, environment and results. Include a short redacted JSON excerpt if the change affects CLI output.

- [ ] Fixtures and excerpts use synthetic or sanitized inputs and omit credentials, private paths and real market data.
- [ ] For CLI or MCP changes, I checked the affected JSON fields, exit codes and dry-run behavior.
- [ ] For evaluation changes, I checked point-in-time timing, label exits, missing IC reasons, and the applicable calibration and trial accounting.
